page.overview:
Who is Gordon?

Gordon is a male Compsognathus who appears in the second season of Jurassic World: Chaos Theory.

Gordon looks like a normal Compsognathus, except his right foot is amputated and has a bandage. Plus he has an Elizabethan collar.

Gordon, the Compsognathus, was caught in a wire, resulting in him losing his right foot. DPW workers Ronnie and Darius were sent to retrieve him and he was brought back to Ronnie's house, now with a bandage on his right leg and an Elizabethan collar.

He was seen first in a cage outside of Ronnie's house, near the balcony, where Brooklynn gives him a bowl of food to which he eats as the girl watches. Later, when corrupted DPW member Jared enters the house and with Brooklynn tries to hide from him, she tries to hide in the balcony, but unwittingly attracted the attention of Gordon, to which she replied with a shush. When Jared enters the the balcony after hearing the noise, he sees nothing but Gordon and leaves. Gordon is still at Ronnie's house when she returned.
